source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to the "Accessibility Non-Compliance" worksheet.
3. Commence accurately mapping the results to the **C0422** or **C1089** forms.

> [!TIP]
> If you encounter a malfunction that involves an accessibility problem other **than a lift/elevator**, you must fill out form "C0422".
>
> On the other hand, if the malfunction relates specifically to a **lift/elevator/stairs/escalator**, you are required to complete form "C1089".
>
> Form "C0422" will always be linked to a new or existing "D739",
> and form "C1089" will always be linked to a new or existing "D741".


To support this manual mapping, you will find a pivot table named 'C0422 + C10
